text: Reputation tokens used in decentralized finance are more meaningful and easier to value than traditional identity verification metrics, so decentralized protocols that use reputation metrics will require less collateralization than traditional protocols.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098
